Introducing HOMEGROWN: the first major update of Duck Side of the Moon.
Ever since the 1.0 release, we couldn’t wait to expand the cozy universe we created. Ideas kept piling up, and Homegrown is what came out of it, and now we finally get to share it with you!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45220133/f124bf8427982d9ceeb4e1d28d79c5d418c55b35.jpg"]

Explore a whole new area, meet new characters and take on a brand-new storyline. Plant, grow and harvest your own crops among the stars. And with chromas, you can now customize every piece of furniture and every wall of your spaceship. We can’t wait to see your styles and designs!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45220133/5968649d522695ae8ad7cc0e650c2f1fd24f9c39.jpg"]
If you've already finished the game, you can just load your existing save and the new content will be waiting for you.

notes.title: How to unlock the new content

items.text: The Homegrown update becomes available after you’ve completed the Power the Boogie quest.

notes.title: There are two ways to start the new quest

items.text: Outside your spaceship: As you exit, you should see them standing right in front of you with a “?” above their head.
Near the Mineshaft: Fly towards the Mineshaft and look for a new, large telescope. You’ll find them standing next to it.
Talk to the character at either location to begin your Homegrown adventure!
Previously, the last few chests all rewarded you with bolts. With the addition of chromas, "Spaceship Wallpapers", we’ve replaced those rewards with something a little more exciting!
If you’ve already opened these chests, Chippy should have a message indication. Talk to Chippy to claim your new rewards.
Watch the Trailer on YouTube.
Thank you all for your support. We hope you’re as excited as we are!

Hey there, fellow Ducknauts!

In the past month since launch (time flies!) we've received some feedback that our pricing was too high in certain currencies and regions. Therefore, we have now updated our regional pricing in a number of territories. Steam’s pricing cooldowns meant we couldn’t make these changes immediately, but we’re glad to have them in place now and hope this helps make the game more accessible to players around the world!

Hey everyone!

We’ve been hard at work tackling some of the biggest remaining issues, and today’s hotfix is a big one. Thank you to everyone who sent in bug reports, save files, and feedback. It really helps us track these down faster.
Please note: some of the fixes listed below contain spoilers for late-game content.
Fixed the Meteor River softlock: the river should now always keep moving, allowing you to obtain the rubber properly
Fixed a rare train building softlock: in the case where Cody (the station NPC) incorrectly considers your track as invalid, talking to Cody again will get you unstuck
The Jukebox now continues to function after completing the ending
The Cosmic Cleanup quest can now be completed after the ending
Fixed a rare issue where Harry’s dialogue at the Mines entrance could freeze input
The train track system received a general quality-of-life pass to make building tracks smoother and less frustrating overall
The final dream now has clearer visual/contextual setup leading into the dream sequence
The basketball and precise challenges will now unlock already upon crafting their recipes, to make these challenges more clear to achieve
Somnium can now be purchased even if your inventory is full
Fixed rare scenario where bowling pins could vanish
Added clearer feedback for Harry’s stash door opening
Rocks around the spaceship no longer reappear after the ending
Crafting wind-up audio is now more robust
Improved general game performance in Lightholm
We hope this update resolves most of the issues that have popped up recently. Thanks again for your patience and support, and enjoy the update!

topNew: The final dream now has clearer visual/contextual setup leading into the dream sequence
Somnium can now be purchased even if your inventory is full
Fixed rare scenario where bowling pins could vanish

items.text: Quack! Hope you all had a great week! We read your messages and it's time for another hotfix! 🦆
Fixed a bug where Shell Hatcher accessories could sometimes not be picked up
Fixed a soft-lock where a gate would sometimes reset after traveling to Lightholm

Fixed a rare soft-lock where a late-game item could disappear after traveling between Lightholm: Please know we’re still working on many more fixes, including the railway repair issue that has been reported a few times, and we’re doing our best to keep up with all your messages.: Thanks as always thank you for your support and patience!: Warmly,: Team Starbrew

We just hit >50 reviews, taking us from Positive to Very Positive! Thank you so much, to everyone who left a review. And if you enjoyed the game and haven't left a review yet, it would mean the world to us if you did!
All that aside, we're continuing addressing some of the issues everyone has reported ❤️
Fixed Gadget UI showing the same gadget icon and name twice when collecting a third gadget.
Fixed not being able to pick up a shell reward due to the shell hatcher interaction volume consuming the interact.

Fixed a rare instance where the game wouldn't continue past the loading screen due to the cinematic not playing. In these cases it might be that the cinematic is skipped to aleast make sure you can load into the game.
Fixed Quantum Storage not saving it's repaired state when travelling between Lightholm and Boogiedale.
Fixed Walter's door staying interactable after opening it, saving and loading.
Fixed Quantum Storage showing a hold interact UI prompt when a press is required to open it after saving and loading.
Fixed Scanner Input Tutorial saying only "Hold" it will now say "Scan (Hold)"
Fixed "Rescue Mission" errand quest requirement not progressing if you pulled the minecart out of the asteroid without first entering the asteroid.
It's been a week since launch now and want to thank you for your kind words and support 🦆

releases.displayName: Duck Side of the Moon - Return to Lightholm Update

items.text: Note: This post contains spoilers for events that take place past "The Slingshot Manouevre" quest.
Hey everyone, the day has finally arrived!
Our most requested feature is finally here. You can now travel between Boogiedale and Lightholm!
Upon retrieving the engines from Gresh you will be able to return to Lightholm by talking to Cody the conductor.
Fixed being able to craft item recipes with a full inventory.
Changed Ending music to be less ear deafeningly loud.
Extended dancing section duration! 🕺🪩
Chippy's notification expression for Frame craftable message is now less sad.
Harry's Stash corridor should be easier to find and less dark.
Mining coaster outcrops respawn faster.
Default camera settings are now set to intended values.
Bowling charge & rotate should be easier and more clear.
Shooting the river for water bubbles is now more consistent.
Many more small fixes.
As always we're still working on many more Changes & Fixes, maybe we'll be here again tomorrow for another hotfix.
Team Starbrew

topNew: Upon retrieving the engines from Gresh you will be able to return to Lightholm by talking to Cody the conductor.

items.text: Hope you all had a great weekend, we saw some new bug reports coming in this weekend and we're hard at work addressing them. Here's what we have resolved so far:
There is now an "Emergency Return" button in the Pause Menu for if you get stuck in / under any terrain. Pressing this button will get you unstuck, but please use it with caution.
Be aware the fixes below contain spoilers for the full game.
Fixed a circumstance where you could never get the Winter Outfit, if you didn't talk to Walter before asking him about a gift for Dragon.
Fixed a soft lock with Astra when on controller giving suggestions for what to give to Dragon and picking the bottom option first between a cake and gifts.
Fixed Power the Boogie and Fix the Engines quests not starting for some players. For players who had this soft lock opening their save again should resolve this issue.
We're still working on many more fixes and hope to have another hotfix out tomorrow.
Another day another hotfix. Thanks everyone for sending in reports, sending over save files, etc. it really helps us track down those nasty bugs!
New (highly requested) Controls settings have been added for Look Sensitivity and Look Smoothing.
Be aware the fixes below contain spoilers for the full game.

Fixed some achievements not being given out. If you have made a save prior to this fix the achievements should be given the moment you load into a save again. Please let us know if you're still missing any.
Fixed some typos in the dialogue.
Fixed the Lightholm conductor hand clipping through the sign he was holding. Finally, I mean the game was pretty much unplayable before this.
Fixed the LOD's for the Rubber making it look suspiciously like Astral Shards. The days of Rubber gaslighting you from a distance are finally over.
Fixed the engines staying in the minecart or in the cart at the Gemstone fields after they had already been fixed.
Increased the range of Scoot's quest marker. He was getting a bit lonely with some many players flying past him.
Fixed Camera issue with Forge Key Chase.
Of course we're still looking into other highly requested fixes and additions such as being able to return to Lightholm, Input Remapping and more.

topNew: New (highly requested) Controls settings have been added for Look Sensitivity and Look Smoothing.

items.text: Quack! Thank you so much for all the support, reviews, streams and posts so far. It really means a lot ❤️
It's time for our first hotfix, addressing some soft locks and general issues. If you find any bugs be sure to let us know either through the Community Hub or through our Discord!
Be aware the patch notes below contain spoilers for the full game.
Fixed a soft lock that would occur when buying Somnium at the Marketplace stall before talking with Gresh at the Marketplace.
Fixed the Roombo Decoration not showing up when crafting.
Fixed a soft lock after extinguishing the fires, where you would no longer be able to swap gadgets.
Fixed Tooltips going off screen on non-HD resolutions when using a controller.
Made End Credits a bit less loud - wouldn't wanna jumpscare anyone after just finishing the game.
Fixed the "Lake Audio" playing while in the forge.
Fixed Saving while floor is lava allowing you to cheat and start flying instead of jumping. Liam does not approve of any cheating that occured!
Fixed a soft lock when transitioning from forge to dancefloor.
Fixed some bowling pins falling over before starting the bowling minigame. I guess the wind in space was blowing a little too hard in snowfell.
